- A written marketing plan and expected timeline
- Their commission and any other fees

Rankings are a useful starting point, not a guarantee; neighborhood-specific experience and a clear pricing strategy matter most. If you share your neighborhood, property type, and approximate value, I can help narrow down what to look for.
